_doc: KC push-notification campaign registry. Campaign type -> audience + fixed key-values. Captured from the live WebEngage UI 2026-08-13. Segment IDs resolved via the cloud function's get_segment_list route. Only `notification_data` (image URLs) and `entity` (item id) change per send; everything else is fixed per type.

_shared_notes.forced_exclusions: The d2r_notification_automation cloud function ALWAYS prepends EXP_SEGMENT = ['~48clbl2','~1i5j875'] to excludedSegments and this cannot be disabled. Types that do not already list them WILL see a slightly smaller audience once automated. See per-type `_exp_segment_delta`.
_shared_notes.notification_data: MUST be sent as a STRINGIFIED JSON string, not an object. An object silently degrades to a plain text notification.
_shared_notes.campaign_tags_kv: The `campaign_tags` key-value is auto-generated by the pipeline from campaignTags (python str() of the list). Do NOT set it by hand.
_shared_notes.title_message: duo_image and multi_icon render NO title/message — all copy lives in the image pixels. titles[]/messages[] are still required by the API as ballast.
_shared_notes.sticky: isSticky MUST be false. Sticky injects a campaign CTA which overrides multi_icon per-badge deep_links.
_shared_notes.campaign_name: Send `campaign_name` (NOT `label`) as campaignName. The cloud function appends ': DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM' itself (utils.py:520), so a label containing the time would duplicate it, e.g. '... Shop Tips 18:00: 13-08-2027 18:02'.

kc_stories_multi_icon.on_click_action: EMPTY — no prime CTA, no action buttons. THIS IS WHY per-badge deep_links work. Must stay empty; isSticky must be false.
